sql: SELECT ROUND(AVG(CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM caseflow.documents d WHERE d.case_id = c.case_id AND d.outcome = 'ask_applicant') THEN 1.0 ELSE 0 END) * 100, 1) AS ask_applicant_rate FROM caseflow.cases c WHERE c.received_at >= DATE '2026-01-01'
explanation: Uses the ask_applicant_rate metric for applications received in 2026.
